scope: Observable-to-source and observable-to-tool traceability. No participant dataset or empirical model fit is created by this map.
correspondence: Every map row has one stable observable identity, source locator, measurement context and destination field. Different endpoint assays use separately declared datasets even when their destination field name is the same. Invertible coordinate representation is conditional on admitted paired positive assays and retained references; causal correspondence requires separate predictions and experiments.

status_definitions.measured: The source reports acquisition of this observable. Participant-level data are not thereby available.
status_definitions.computed: A defined transformation or representation of supplied measurements/protocol values; not an additional measurement.
status_definitions.unmeasured: No direct measurement reported in the named study.
status_definitions.unresolved: An assay identity, required datum, hypothesis, timing or linkage remains unestablished.

tool_contract.input_schema_note: Matches current release CSV/metadata names; software release version is independent of input schema.
tool_contract.optional_endpoint: One specified assay identity per dataset; simultaneous sample binding or explicitly separate linked outcome record is required.
tool_contract.auxiliary_fields: Additional CSV columns are retained as extra_fields without inference.
tool_contract.import_rule: Group means, medians, IQRs, SEMs and figure points cannot stand in for paired participant samples or individual measurement intervals.

conditional_numeric_inputs.oxygen: Required for arterial_po2 and tissue_po2; for dry_inspired_po2 it is computed as fio2 * pressure_kpa when omitted, or checked for exact agreement when supplied.
conditional_numeric_inputs.endpoint: Optional; a present value and its baseline must be strictly positive and must use the one declared endpoint identity.

tool_contract.positivity: ros, scavenger, their admitted interval lower bounds, and optional endpoint are strictly positive. FiO2 lies in [0,1]; pressure_kpa is positive. Dry inspired oxygen can be zero; measured arterial/tissue pO2 is positive in the current interface.
tool_contract.separate_endpoint_records: Endpoint-only or differently timed measurements stay in a linked source table. The paired CSV interface requires both positive assays on each imported row.

retained_prior_study_audit.finding: Proposes antioxidant persistence after oxygen return; explicitly leaves the ROS–HIF mechanism and exposure timing unresolved.
retained_prior_study_audit.tool_implication: Retain oxygen, redox state, endpoint, and history as separate records. Use primary studies for protocol details.
retained_prior_study_audit.access: Full text inspected; no original participant dataset.

retained_prior_study_audit.design: 12 healthy adults, four per group; one-hour oxygen exposures; baseline and 0.5/3/24-hour recovery samples.
retained_prior_study_audit.finding: PBMC HIF-1alpha activation differed by exposure. The 100% arm retained an early response. GSH was measured; ROS was not directly measured.
retained_prior_study_audit.tool_implication: No observed ROS/GSH ratio can be reconstructed from this study alone. Keep PBMC HIF-1alpha distinct from renal HIF-2alpha/EPO.
source_flags: Methods/figures use 3 hours; a discussion sentence says 4.
Methods and figures describe intracellular reduced GSH; section heading says plasma total glutathione.
Pressure is described using both bar and ATA; preserve and resolve the unit.
The 140% shorthand requires a separate pressure field; FiO2 remains at most 1.
retained_prior_study_audit.access: Full text inspected. Data available from authors on request; no subject-level data bundled.

retained_prior_study_audit.design: 20 exposed and 20 control ICU patients, sequential nonrandomized allocation. Return to individual baseline FiO2; redox subset 12 per group.
retained_prior_study_audit.finding: Transient serum ROS rise, later GSH rise, and a within-exposure-group EPO increase at 48 hours were reported.
retained_prior_study_audit.tool_implication: Preserve individual baseline, serum compartment, and within-group versus between-group estimand; measure local oxygen independently.
retained_prior_study_audit.access: Full text inspected. Data available on reasonable request.

retained_prior_study_audit.design: Ten healthy men, counterbalanced air/oxygen crossover, one two-hour exposure per condition.
retained_prior_study_audit.finding: Early plasma EPO suppression after oxygen; air-condition EPO varied with time of day.
retained_prior_study_audit.tool_implication: Keep contrary results and clock-matched controls in model evaluation. This acute study was not seven daily exposures.
retained_prior_study_audit.access: Primary abstract inspected; full text not retrieved.

retained_prior_study_audit.design: Eighteen men; oxygen followed by mild hypoxia versus air.
retained_prior_study_audit.finding: No significant between-group absolute EPO increase; early relative changes were lower after the intervention.
retained_prior_study_audit.tool_implication: A larger oxygen transition does not itself establish an EPO response.
retained_prior_study_audit.access: Primary abstract inspected; full text not retrieved.

retained_prior_study_audit.citation: Khalife et al. (2021), Frontiers in Physiology 12, 744074
retained_prior_study_audit.design: DIEP breast reconstruction; 26 enrolled, 22 analyzed; repeated oxygen compared with controls sharing perioperative oxygen exposure.
retained_prior_study_audit.finding: EPO increased within both groups; no significant between-group EPO, reticulocyte or hemoglobin difference.
retained_prior_study_audit.tool_implication: Store control exposure history and postoperative covariates; a within-group rise does not identify an intervention effect.
retained_prior_study_audit.access: Full text inspected. Raw data offered through authors.

retained_prior_study_audit.citation: Khalife et al. (2024), Journal of Anesthesia, Analgesia and Critical Care 4, 43
retained_prior_study_audit.design: Post hoc report of a randomized abdominal-cancer surgery study; 33 analyzed, 16 exposed and 17 controls.
retained_prior_study_audit.finding: Reticulocyte percentage change differed between groups; hemoglobin change did not. EPO was not measured.
retained_prior_study_audit.tool_implication: Preserve reticulocytes as the measured outcome; retain the EPO intermediate as unmeasured.
retained_prior_study_audit.access: Full text inspected. Data available on reasonable request.

retained_prior_study_audit.tool_implication: Retain source compartment and signaling direction as tested variables when transporting a mechanism into NOP.
retained_prior_study_audit.access: Primary abstract and indexed full-text excerpts inspected.
